title: Navratri Garba Night Portrait in Mirror-Work Outfit
prompt:
Edit the photo I uploaded into a festive Navratri garba night portrait. Keep my face exactly as it is: same features, skin tone, expression and hairstyle. The person must stay an adult and look like me.

Outfit: a traditional garba outfit in deep red, marigold yellow and green with small round mirror work and thread embroidery. For a skirt look use a flared ghagra with a matching blouse and dupatta; for a kurta look use a kediyu-style top with dhoti pants. Add oxidised silver jewellery and a pair of decorated dandiya sticks held loosely in one hand.

Setting: an open-air garba ground at night with strings of warm bulbs overhead, blurred dancers in a circle behind me, and a small decorated mata shrine glowing far in the background.

Lighting and camera: warm tungsten fairy lights as the key light, a soft rim light from behind, shallow depth of field like an 85mm lens at f/1.8, slight motion blur on the background dancers only.

Format: vertical 4:5 portrait, natural colours, no text, no watermark, no logos. Avoid plastic-looking skin, extra fingers and changes to my face shape.

title: Durga Puja Pandal Portrait in Red-Border White Saree
prompt:
Turn my uploaded photo into a Durga Puja evening portrait. Keep my face exactly as it is, with my real features, skin texture and expression. Adults only.

Styling: a white cotton saree with a broad red border (a lal-paar style), a red bindi, simple gold-tone jewellery and a few fresh flowers in the hair. If the photo shows a man, use a cream kurta with a red-bordered cotton stole instead.

Setting: standing at the edge of a large, brightly lit pandal. Behind me, out of focus, are carved decorative arches, rows of hanging lamps and a crowd in festive clothes. A faint haze of incense smoke drifts through the light. Do not show a clear image of the deity; keep the background soft.

Lighting: warm golden light from the pandal on one side of my face, cooler blue night ambience on the other, gentle glow on the saree border.

Camera: eye-level, 50mm look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on my eyes.

Format: 4:5 vertical, realistic photo style, no text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid changing my body shape or adding heavy makeup.

title: Dussehra Night Greeting Card With Fireworks Over the Ground
prompt:
Create a Dussehra (Vijayadashami) greeting card image.

Scene: a wide open festival ground at dusk. In the middle distance stands a tall, colourful festival effigy made of bamboo and painted paper, just beginning to glow as fireworks burst in the sky above it. A crowd is seen only as small silhouettes from behind at the bottom of the frame. Strings of lights line the edge of the ground.

Style: rich, cinematic illustration with a slightly painterly finish, deep indigo sky turning orange near the horizon, sparks in gold and saffron.

Composition: leave clean empty sky in the top third for a greeting. Write the text "Happy Dussehra" in an elegant serif font in warm gold in that space, and a smaller line below it: "[Your name or shop name]". Spell every word exactly as given.

Format: 1:1 square for WhatsApp and Instagram, plus keep important details away from the edges so it can be cropped to 9:16.

Avoid: gore, weapons pointed at people, any real politician or celebrity, brand logos, extra text.

title: Karwa Chauth Moonrise Couple Portrait Photo Edit
prompt:
Edit the photo I uploaded of me and my partner (both adults) into a Karwa Chauth moonrise portrait. Keep both of our faces exactly as they are: same features, skin tones, expressions and hairstyles. Do not swap or blend faces.

Scene: a rooftop terrace at night. A full moon rises low and large over the city skyline. One of us holds a decorated steel sieve (channi) at chest height and looks toward the moon; the other stands close, holding a small brass plate with a lit diya and a glass of water.

Styling: festive outfits in deep red and maroon with gold embroidery, simple jewellery, mehendi on the hands. Keep clothing modest and traditional.

Lighting: cool silver moonlight from above, warm diya light from below on our faces, a few fairy lights along the terrace railing.

Camera: medium shot from slightly below eye level, 50mm look, soft background with gentle bokeh.

Format: 4:5 vertical, natural photographic look, no text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid extra hands, distorted fingers, and changes to our faces or body shapes.

title: Diwali Balcony Portrait Surrounded by Diyas
prompt:
Turn my uploaded photo into a warm Diwali evening portrait. Keep my face exactly as it is, with the same features, skin tone and expression. Adults only.

Scene: I am sitting on the ledge of a home balcony decorated for Diwali. Rows of small clay diyas line the railing and the floor in front of me. Warm fairy lights hang from the ceiling. In the distance behind me, other buildings glow with lights and a few small fireworks sparkle in the night sky.

Outfit: festive ethnic wear in a jewel tone (emerald, deep purple or royal blue) with subtle gold detailing. If I'm wearing glasses in the photo, keep them.

Lighting: the diyas are the main light source, giving a soft golden glow on my face from below and the side. Keep the shadows gentle and natural.

Camera: three-quarter view, 85mm portrait look at f/2, sharp eyes, creamy background bokeh from the city lights.

Format: 4:5 vertical, realistic photo, rich but not oversaturated colours, no text, no logos, no watermark. Avoid smoke covering my face and any change to my facial features.

title: Diwali Rangoli Design, Top-Down Floor View
prompt:
Design a Diwali rangoli seen from directly above, as if photographed from a ladder.

Pattern: a symmetrical circular rangoli about 1.2 metres wide. Centre: a lotus with eight petals. Middle ring: alternating peacock-feather and paisley motifs. Outer ring: a border of small dots and leaf shapes. Place eight lit clay diyas evenly around the outside edge.

Colours: [choose a palette, e.g. magenta, saffron, turquoise and white] in powdered colour with crisp, clean edges, plus a few marigold petals scattered in the centre.

Surface: a smooth grey stone floor with a slight texture, lit by the diyas and soft warm light from the side.

Style: realistic photograph, sharp from edge to edge, every line clear enough that someone could copy the design by hand.

Format: 1:1 square. No people, no hands, no text, no logos. Avoid smudged colours, broken symmetry and uneven petal counts.

title: Diwali Offer WhatsApp Broadcast Messages for a Local Shop
prompt:
You are a copywriter for small Indian shops. Write WhatsApp broadcast messages for my Diwali offer.

Shop details:
- Shop name: [shop name]
- What we sell: [e.g. sweets, clothes, electronics, home decor]
- City / area: [area]
- Offer: [exact offer, e.g. 10% off on orders above ₹1,500]
- Offer dates: [start date] to [end date]
- How to order: [walk-in / call / WhatsApp reply / delivery radius]
- Language: [English / Hindi / Hinglish / other]

Write:
1. A launch message (60-90 words) announcing the offer.
2. A reminder message (40-60 words) for the middle of the offer period, with one product suggestion.
3. A last-day message (30-50 words) with a clear deadline.
4. A thank-you message for after Diwali (30-50 words) with no selling.

Rules:
- Use only the details I gave. Do not invent prices, discounts, stock levels or reviews. If something is missing, write [VERIFY: ...] in its place.
- Friendly, respectful tone; at most 2 emojis per message.
- End messages 1-3 with one clear action (reply, call or visit).
- Add a line at the end of message 1: "Reply STOP to stop receiving offers."

Quality check before you answer: every number in your messages appears in my details above.

title: Dhanteras Jewellery Store Product Ad Image
prompt:
Create a premium product ad image for a jewellery shop's Dhanteras offer.

Product: [describe the piece, e.g. a gold-tone necklace with small red stones and a matching pair of earrings]. If I upload a photo of the real piece, keep its design, stone count and shape exactly as in my photo.

Set: the jewellery rests on a deep maroon velvet display bust and tray. Around it, slightly out of focus: three lit clay diyas, a small brass kalash, a few marigold flowers and scattered rice grains on a dark wooden surface.

Lighting: soft studio key light from the upper left to make the metal shine, warm diya glow as fill, a dark background that falls off to black at the edges.

Text (spell exactly): headline "Dhanteras Collection" at the top in a refined serif font; at the bottom "[Shop name] · [City]" and "[Offer line, e.g. Making charges offer on select designs]".

Format: 4:5 for Instagram feed. Keep the text clear of the product.

Avoid: any brand logos other than the shop name I give, invented prices or purity marks, people or hands, cluttered props.

title: Pet Reimagined as a Human Portrait
prompt:
Look at the photo of my pet that I uploaded and imagine what it would look like as an adult human. Create a portrait of that person.

Carry over from the pet:
- Coat colours and markings become hair colour, hairstyle and clothing colours and patterns.
- Eye colour stays the same.
- Personality from the photo (sleepy, curious, proud, mischievous) shows in the expression and pose.
- Any collar, bandana or tag becomes a matching accessory.

Rules: the person must be a clearly adult, fictional character. Do not make them look like any real or famous person. Keep clothing everyday and fully covered.

Setting: the same place as in my pet photo (sofa, garden, bed), recreated at human scale.

Style: [choose: realistic photo / soft 3D animation / watercolour illustration], warm natural light, 50mm portrait look.

Output: one image showing my original pet photo on the left and the human version on the right, side by side, 3:2 landscape. No text, no logos.

title: Imperfect Film Photo Edit With Light Leaks and Grain
prompt:
Edit my uploaded photo so it looks like a real print from a cheap film camera, not a polished digital image. Keep my face exactly as it is: same features, skin texture, pores and expression. Do not smooth my skin or change my face shape.

Apply:
- Visible but fine film grain across the whole frame, a little stronger in the shadows.
- One soft orange-red light leak entering from the [left/right] edge, covering no more than a quarter of the frame.
- Slightly lifted blacks and gentle fade, warm highlights, colours similar to an expired consumer colour negative film.
- A small amount of softness at the corners and slight vignetting.
- Optional: a faint date stamp in orange digits in the bottom-right corner reading "[date]".

Keep: the original composition, background and clothing. Nothing is added or removed from the scene.

Format: same aspect ratio as my photo. No borders unless I ask, no logos, no watermark. Avoid heavy blur, glitch effects and fake dust that covers my face.

title: Turn Your Photo Into a Fictional Movie Poster
prompt:
Turn the photo I uploaded into a poster for a movie that does not exist. Keep my face exactly as it is, with the same features and expression. Adults only.

Movie details:
- Title: "[your made-up title]"
- Genre: [thriller / romantic comedy / sci-fi / family drama / action]
- One-line tagline: "[your tagline]"

Design:
- Place me as the lead character in the centre, in an outfit and pose that fit the genre.
- Background and colour grading should match the genre (e.g. cold blue and teal for sci-fi, warm sunset tones for romance, high-contrast shadows for thriller).
- Title in large, bold type in the lower third, tagline in smaller type above it.
- At the bottom, a short credit block with made-up names only: "A [your name] Production" and "Coming Soon".

Rules: do not use any real studio logos, rating badges, streaming service logos or real actors' names. Spell every word exactly as given.

Format: 2:3 vertical, cinematic, sharp focus on my face.

title: Friendly Roast Caricature From Your Photo
prompt:
Make a light-hearted caricature of me from the photo I uploaded. It should look clearly like me, with the same face, hairstyle and expression, just playfully exaggerated.

How to exaggerate:
- Pick my two most noticeable features (for example a big smile, strong eyebrows, curly hair or glasses) and enlarge them gently.
- Keep the body small with a big head, in a classic caricature style.

The roast: around me, add 4 small drawn props or labels that tease my habits in a friendly way, based on these notes: [list 3-5 harmless habits, e.g. "always late", "100 browser tabs open", "orders the same chai every day"]. Write each label in short, clear handwritten-style text and spell it exactly as written.

Tone: funny but kind. No jokes about weight, skin colour, religion, disability or appearance beyond the playful exaggeration. Nothing rude or adult.

Style: hand-drawn digital caricature with bold outlines and soft colour, plain light background.

Format: 4:5 vertical, no logos, no watermark.

title: Time-Travel Portrait: Place Yourself in a Past Decade
prompt:
Place me in a past decade using the photo I uploaded. Keep my face exactly as it is: same features, skin tone and expression. Adults only.

Decade and place: [choose one, e.g. 1960s Bombay seaside promenade / 1920s Paris café / 1980s Delhi market street / 1970s New York subway platform].

Make it period-accurate:
- Clothing, hairstyle and accessories that ordinary people wore in that decade and place.
- Background buildings, vehicles, signs (with made-up or unreadable shop names) and street details from that time.
- No modern objects: no smartphones, no modern cars, no LED lights.

Photo style: match the photography of that era. For example, slightly faded colour film for the 1960s-80s, or black-and-white with soft grain for the 1920s-40s.

Composition: candid street-photo feel, me in the middle ground, other people in period clothing passing by (all fictional, none resembling famous people).

Format: 3:2 landscape, no text overlays, no logos, no watermark.

title: Kling 4.0 Multi-Keyframe Product Reveal Video
prompt:
Generate a 10-second product reveal video using three keyframes.

Product: [describe your product, e.g. a matte black insulated water bottle]. If you attach a product image, keep its shape, colours and proportions exactly as shown.

Keyframe 1 (0s): the product stands in near darkness on a wet black stone surface; only a thin line of light catches its top edge.
Keyframe 2 (5s): a soft warm light sweeps across from left to right, revealing the full product and its texture; small water droplets on the surface sparkle.
Keyframe 3 (10s): the product sits fully lit and centred, with a gentle reflection on the stone and a clean dark gradient background.

Camera: one continuous slow push-in from a medium shot to a close-up across the full 10 seconds. No cuts, no shake.

Motion: only the light and a few falling droplets move; the product stays still.

Sound: soft low ambient hum, one subtle chime when the product is fully lit at the end. No music with vocals, no dialogue.

Format: 16:9, 1080p or higher, no on-screen text, no logos other than any already printed on my product.

title: Black Friday Sale Email Sequence for a Small Online Store
prompt:
You are an email marketer for small online stores. Write a 5-email Black Friday sequence.

Store details:
- Store name: [name]
- What we sell: [products]
- Customer type: [who buys from us]
- Offer: [exact discount or bundle]
- Sale dates: [dates, e.g. Black Friday to Cyber Monday]
- Shipping or return policy worth mentioning: [details or "none"]
- Brand voice: [e.g. warm and simple / playful / premium and calm]

Emails:
1. Early notice (3-5 days before): what's coming, ask them to save the date.
2. Sale is live (Black Friday morning): the offer and the 3 best products to start with.
3. Gift-help email (Saturday): products grouped by who they're for.
4. Last call (Monday): honest deadline.
5. Thank-you (after the sale): no discount, just thanks and one helpful tip about using a product.

For each email give: subject line (under 50 characters), preview text (under 90 characters), and body (80-150 words) with one call-to-action button label.

Rules: use only the facts I gave. No fake countdowns, invented scarcity, made-up reviews or numbers. Mark anything missing as [VERIFY: ...]. Include an unsubscribe reminder line in each footer.

Check before answering: every claim matches my details.

title: Guru Nanak Jayanti Greeting Card With Lamps at Dusk
prompt:
Create a respectful Guru Nanak Jayanti (Gurpurab) greeting card image.

Scene: a white marble courtyard with a calm water pool at dusk. Hundreds of small lamps and candles line the edge of the pool and the steps, their reflections shimmering in the water. Strings of warm lights outline a domed building in the soft-focus background. A few people seen only as distant silhouettes with covered heads walk along the side.

Do not depict the Guru or any religious figure; keep the focus on light, water and architecture.

Style: peaceful, realistic photograph feel, deep blue sky fading to warm gold near the horizon, gentle reflections.

Text (spell exactly): at the top in an elegant serif font, "Happy Gurpurab". Below in smaller type: "Warm wishes on Guru Nanak Jayanti" and "[Your name or business name]".

Format: 1:1 square, with text in the upper third and clear of the lamps. No logos, no watermark. Avoid crowds facing the camera and any real person's likeness.
